name: inference_engine
description: Core inference engine. In the skeleton, this wraps an LLM for general reasoning. A full implementation would integrate symbolic reasoning, neural inference, and hybrid approaches.

inference_modes.name: fast
inference_modes.description: Single-pass autoregressive generation. Low latency, good for routine tasks.

inference_modes.name: deliberate
inference_modes.description: Chain-of-thought with self-critique. Higher latency, better for novel problems.

inference_modes.name: formal
inference_modes.description: Delegates to formal verifier for provably correct reasoning.
